units: Maas. Sh. II, 3 תלתן … תאכל צ׳ fenugrec dedicated as second tithes may be used as buds (directly from the capsules, before they are dry); [R. S.: the growth from seeds of fenugrec dedicated as second tithes and not redeemed, may be eaten]. Y. ib. 53ᶜ top כיני … מותרת להיאכל צ׳ the Mishnah means to say may be (not must be) eaten &c.; Tosef. ib. II, 1 צִמְחוֹנוֹת.
